svg.text: · Sortable by time inside one machine; across machines it is only roughly ordered (clock skew).

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · Throughput ceiling is 4,096 ids/ms/generator — 4.096M/s per node.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · A backwards clock step is the failure to guard: refuse to emit, or borrow the next millisecond.
